Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + tech deep-dive scheduling (please confirm attendees)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same next-steps: 

- Goal: Reduce inference cost by 40% for batch scoring and keep 95th p90 latency under 120ms for the customer-facing API.
- Primary constraints: PCI-scope data, private VPC preferred, current infra on GCP us-west1.
- Key stakeholders: you (SaaS product), Tom (platform/infra), and your security contact (TBD).

Next step we agreed on: 60m technical deep-dive with our serving engineer to review integration pattern, KV cache expectations, and rollout options. I’ve provisionally scheduled that deep-dive for Tue, Jan 19 at 10:00 AM PT and sent a calendar hold (invite-jan19.ics attached). Can you confirm attendees below so we include the right engineering owners?

Proposed agenda (attached as deep-dive-agenda.pdf):
- 10m quick orientation + success metrics
- 30m architecture walkthrough (integration checklist attached)
- 15m performance/cost Q&A
- 5m next steps and owner alignment

Please reply with: 1) Confirm OK for Jan 19 10:00 PT OR 2) If that doesn’t work, share two windows you can commit to this week. If it helps, here are alternate slots we can offer: Wed 1/20 9:00–10:00 PT or Thu 1/21 11:00–12:00 PT.

If I don’t hear back by EOD tomorrow I’ll follow up — want to lock the slot since our Eng availability is limited this window.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

I’m really sorry — I got pulled into an executive incident call and we missed the deep-dive this morning. My fault on coordination.

We still want to move forward, but this week is chaotic. Tom and I are available only in the mornings next week (Jan 24–28) between 9:00–12:00 PT. Can you propose a tight set of slots and we’ll lock one? Also, can you include the engineer who will run the perf discussion (we’ll want their LinkedIn/role so we can prep).

Again, apologies — hate to waste your team’s time.

Hi Samantha —

No worries — totally understand. To make this quick, can you please CONFIRM one of the two tight slots below by replying with the slot number (so we can lock it and send updated invites)? Our eng lead Markus (cc’d) will run the perf/cost portion. Short profile: Markus Klein — Staff Inference Engineer (runtime & kernels), markus.klein@redwoodinference.com.

Option 1 — Tue, Jan 24 10:00–11:00 AM PT (recommended — Markus available)
Option 2 — Wed, Jan 25 09:00–10:00 AM PT

If neither works, reply with two 30–60 minute morning windows next week and we’ll triage. To make the confirmation binding: please reply with exactly the word CONFIRM + Option 1 or CONFIRM + Option 2. That avoids back-and-forth and we’ll treat a CONFIRM reply as a firm lock.

I’ve attached the agenda and the integration checklist again for Tom’s review. If OK I’ll send updated calendar invites with dialing details. Calendar quick-pick: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Thanks — looking forward to digging in.

—Jonas
